subtitle: Progress Command — Unified Planning Intelligence
changes: Added Progress Command, a read-only cross-studio dashboard combining manually saved Item Atlas, Character Targets, Loot Hunter, and Farming Operations records
Summarizes local items, manual ownership, active goals, completed targets, and recorded farming-session attempts without double-counting separate tracking systems
Added character-level overview, prioritized open objectives, and one-click navigation back to the source studios
Surfaces orphaned Character Targets, manually owned items still marked as open objectives, and overlapping Item Atlas/Loot Hunter records as review suggestions only
Exports a compact privacy-conscious JSON summary of counts and character progress; no private Blizzard account tokens or account profile payloads
Preserves v3.3 secure Battle.net My Azeroth, read-only gear intelligence, item API, and all existing storage formats
No Cloudflare Worker update or additional variables required for this browser-local release
